snippet.title: Pokitaire Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Explore a new twist to the classic Spider Solitaire in Pokitaire! Turning this classic puzzle game into a score chasing arcade puzzle game with this solitaire and poker hybrid. Clear cards by playing poker hands instead of simply sorting them and chase highscores instead of only clearing cards.

Demo available in both itch.io and Steam!
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3787840/Pokitaire_Demo/
itch.io: https://zepphy.itch.io/pokitaire

Don't forget to wishlist the full game on Steam to notify you when it's out! The full version, for now, will be done soon™
